summary: Enterprise Live Migrations (ELM) from Azure DevOps Services to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency is now generally available. You can move your repositories while your teams keep working, then cut over on your schedule.
takeaways: Cut over on your schedule: ELM continuously syncs changes from Azure DevOps to GitHub, so developers can keep contributing throughout the migration.
Bring your development history with you: ELM syncs Git history, branches, tags, and pull requests, including titles, descriptions, comments, and user history.
Your Azure DevOps branch policies migrate as GitHub branch rulesets.
